plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-011 Clear suggestion on saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Apply the requested tenant configuration for vendor addition during event creation.
Give the draft a title so it can be saved and reopened from Drafts.
Configure an eRFX draft with an RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add a product so the saved draft has product context for the suggestion.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft required by the case.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the draft created for this test.
Click the Clear control and record what it opens or changes without confirming any unrelated dialog.
Verify the Clear result displays the suggestion heading.
Verify the expected Invite suggestion text is present.
Verify the expected participant-count suggestion text is present.
Verify the suggestion explains that it is based on the products.
